name: chart-kit
title: Chart kit
description: The shared parts of the Tiles charts: number formatting with a muted unit, nice axis ticks, a smooth line, one tooltip, the big display figure, a change pill, a pill switch and a table for screen readers.

props.name: x
props.description: Where the tooltip points, in px inside the chart's positioned wrapper.

props.name: bounds
props.description: The wrapper's width, so the tooltip stays inside it.

props.name: below
props.description: Above the point by default; below when the point sits near the top.

props.name: title
props.description: The small label on top, such as the date.

props.name: size
props.description: xl for the one figure a tile is about, sm for a figure inside a chart. Default "lg".

props.name: roll
props.description: Roll the digits that change. Default true; never under reduced motion.

props.name: label
props.description: Read aloud for the group, e.g. "Period".

a11y.text: BigNumber carries the full value in sr-only text and the visual is aria-hidden. DeltaPill adds ", up", ", down" or ", unchanged". ChartTooltip is aria-hidden. SrTable is a visually hidden table with a caption and column headers with scope.

Pills is a radio group with roving focus: arrows, Home and End move the choice, and up and down act like right and left. stepIndex in chart-utils moves by ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, Home and End, or ArrowUp and ArrowDown when vertical.
Under reduced motion the digits do not roll and the tooltip transition is off. useChartFrame reports reduced and treats the chart as drawn at once.
